description: Fetch a full profile for a labeled agent on Base: identity, 24h/7d transaction stats, 7-day balance history (hourly buckets), 30-day gas history (daily), the most recent 20 transactions, and any related published Decodes. Returns 404 if ChainWard does not label this address. Heavier than lookup_agent — use when the user wants detail.
name: get_agent_profile
